```bash
ls -la checkpoints/qwen3-8b-fewnerd-exp021-merged/*.safetensors | wc -l
```

先确认脚本参数：
```bash
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

```

```bash

  --n_samples 8 \

  --collect_logprobs \
```
